title: Slot occupancy audit - regional daily scan (APAC/EU/NA)
summary: Daily export of GPU slot occupancy across clusters and pools with per-slot timestamps, active workloads, and idle-to-active transition counts. Purpose: identify fragmentation, low-fill pools, and candidate clusters for consolidation or pre-warming. This sheet is an intermediate audit used by capacity-planning and SRE to propose short-term reclaiming targets.
dataset_overview: Source: internal occupancy-export job (export-v3) run at 00:00 UTC. Row = single GPU slot sample point. Columns: timestamp_utc, region, cluster_id, pool_id, instance_type, slot_id, slot_state (idle|reserved|active|draining), active_workload_id (nullable), tokens_per_minute_est, avg_rpc_latency_ms, last_transition_seconds. Sampling frequency: 5m snapshot; retention window scanned: 2026-03-24 00:00:00 to 2026-03-24 23:55:00 UTC (288 samples per slot). Aggregation steps applied: per-slot occupancy rate, per-pool mean fill, fragmentation index (slots with >3 small workloads), and 95th percentile latency for active slots.
key_metrics:
- Global fleet: 16,824 GPU slots monitored
- Average fleet occupancy (24h): 72.3%
- Median per-cluster occupancy: 75.8%
- Number of pools with avg occupancy <40%: 12
- Fragmentation index (fleet-level): 0.18 (fraction of slots with >=3 short-lived workloads in window)
- Idle-to-active transitions (24h): 4,112 (spikes at 00:05 and 09:40 UTC)
- Mean tokens/minute on active slots: 1,250
- 95th latency for active slots: 82 ms
per_region_breakdown: NA: 7,420 slots monitored — avg occupancy 78.1% — tail latency (95th) 75 ms — notable: pool n-pool-c12 shows diurnal dip to 42% between 03:00-06:00 local
EU: 5,280 slots monitored — avg occupancy 69.4% — tail latency (95th) 88 ms — notable: cluster eu-ml-7 has persistent reserved state due to long-running experiments (48h+)

APAC: 4,124 slots monitored — avg occupancy 64.0% — tail latency (95th) 92 ms — notable: apac-gpu-mix pools show high fragmentation index 0.27 driven by short inference bursts from internal test suites
anomalies_found: Cluster eu-ml-7: 312 slots in 'reserved' state for >24h — owner tag absent in metadata — suspected orphaned reserved allocations from experiment-ops

Pool apac-burst-9: occupancy drops to 17% during local night yet shows average tokens/minute per active slot 2,400 when active — indicates bursty, high-intensity job shape leading to underutilized baseline capacity

Cluster na-hpc-2: measured avg_rpc_latency increased by +40ms between 09:30-10:15 UTC correlated with sudden increase in idle-to-active transitions — possible scheduling churn or autoscaler oscillation
follow_up_actions: Assign eu-ml-7 investigation: Contact experiments-team to release or convert long-reserved slots (owner: Marcus Nguyen) — target: reclaim 120 slots by 2026-04-01
Create autoscale policy tweak for apac-burst pools: lower persistent min_capacity by 15% and enable pre-warm window 30m prior to predicted bursts — A/B test for 2 weeks
Deploy short-lived-job tagging enforcement: ensure jobs <10m set 'ephemeral=true' to allow packing scheduler to co-locate — infra PR #298
SRE runbook update: add check for sudden idle-to-active spike (threshold: >3x baseline in 15m) that triggers redispatch alert and temporary increase in placement window
